falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $71,500 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakout above the August 2024 high would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, which requires price to remain below that resistance level. It would signal renewed bullish momentum rather than continued basing/consolidation.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rate on Binance BTC perpetual exceeds 0.05% for 3 consecutive 8-hour intervals
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained positive funding above this threshold indicates leveraged longs are aggressively piling in, contradicting the HOLD signal which assumes weak speculative demand and low conviction typical of a bottoming phase.

falsification_conditions.condition: BTC spot ETF daily net inflow exceeds $500M on any single day
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: An inflow spike of this magnitude would show institutional accumulation far stronger than the bottom_2024_aug analog, where ETF flows were muted. It would suggest the market is transitioning to a demand-driven rally, not a quiet basing period.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
